soal: 1. What is the correct instruction based someone opening a door ?
pilihan: A. Close the door, please
B. Open the door, please
C. Sweep the room
D. Sit down, please

soal: 2. Which sentence is an instruction?
pilihan: A. Would you like to join us?
B. Don’t be late
C. Open your book, please
D. May I go outside?

soal: 3. What is the correct response to “Clean the table, please”?
pilihan: A. No, thanks
B. Sure
C. Sorry, you can’t
D. I don’t mind

soal: 4. Which sentence shows asking someone to do something?
pilihan: A. Could you help me fix the boat?
B. Don’t touch the water
C. May I borrow your hat?
D. Open the gate, please

soal: 5. Which is the correct reply for the request “Would you like to go to the beach?”
pilihan: A. No problem
B. Yes, of course
C. Don’t be noisy
D. I’m sorry, you aren’t allowed

soal: 6. What is the correct prohibition expression?
pilihan: A. You mustn’t be lazy
B. Let’s go swimming
C. Can I join you?
D. Sweep the floor

soal: 7. Which sentence is a response to a prohibition?
pilihan: A. Yes, here you are
B. Alright
C. Sorry, I won’t
D. I’d love to

soal: 8. Which question shows asking for permission?
pilihan: A. Don’t forget your equipment
B. May I swim in the sea?
C. Clean your room!
D. Would you like to help me?

soal: 9. How many children are on the beach?
pilihan: A. There is a child on the beach
B. There are many children on the beach
C. There is only one children on the beach
D. There aren’t any child on the beach

soal: 10. Which sentence uses the correct quantifier for people?
pilihan: A. There is many people in the hall
B. There are a few people in the room
C. There is some people in the park
D. There are a little people in the yard

soal: 11. How many birds are there on the beach?
pilihan: A. There is a bird on the beach
B. There are a lot of birds on the beach
C. There is many birds on the beach
D. There are a few bird on the beach

soal: 12. Which question is correct for uncountable nouns?
pilihan: A. How many sand is on the beach?
B. How much sand is on the beach?
C. How many sands are on the beach?
D. How much sands are on the beach?

soal: 13. Which sentence is correct?
pilihan: A. My car is new than yours
B. My car is newer than yours
C. My car is the newer of all
D. My car is more new than yours

soal: 14. Which quantifier fits this sentence: “There is … money in my wallet”?
pilihan: A. a few
B. many
C. a little
D. some

soal: 15. Which sentence shows a daily activity (Simple Present)?
pilihan: A. The fishermen are going to the sea now
B. They went to the market yesterday
C. They go to the sea at 6 p.m. every day
D. They are taking a rest right now

soal: 16. Which adverb of frequency means ‘rarely’?
pilihan: A. Always
B. Occasionally
C. Seldom
D. Never

soal: 17. What are the farmers doing?
pilihan: A. They plant the tree
B. They are cultivating the rice farm
C. They cultivate rice yesterday
D. They will cultivate rice

soal: 18. Which sentence uses the Present Continuous correctly?
pilihan: A. She cook dinner now
B. She is cook dinner now
C. She is cooking dinner now
D. She cooking dinner now

soal: 19. What is the carpenter doing?
pilihan: A. He is cut the wood
B. He is cutting the wood
C. He cuts the wood yesterday
D. He cut the wood

soal: 20. Which is the correct personal pronoun pair?
pilihan: A. He – her
B. She – him
C. They – them
D. It – their

soal: 21. Complete the sentence: “Aji is waiting for Yani. He is waiting for …”
pilihan: A. she
B. her
C. hers
D. herself

soal: 22. Which sentence uses the positive degree correctly?
pilihan: A. A tiger is strong than a lion
B. A tiger is the strongest a lion
C. A tiger is as strong as a lion
D. A tiger is stronger as a lion

soal: 23. Which sentence is a comparative degree?
pilihan: A. Rina is as tall as Sinta
B. Rina is taller than Sinta
C. Rina is the tallest girl
D. Sinta is tall

soal: 24. Which is a superlative sentence?
pilihan: A. He is stronger than Budi
B. He is as strong as Budi
C. He is the strongest in the class
D. He is strong

soal: 25. Which sentence is correct according to page 16 (Present Continuous table)?
pilihan: A. They are build a bridge
B. They are building a bridge
C. They build a bridge now
D. They is building a bridge
